scenes.heading: Building a repeatable client onboarding process for buyers and sellers

sents.d: Building a repeatable client onboarding process for buyers and sellers
Buyers and sellers need different onboarding approaches.

Buyer onboarding typically includes understanding budget and financing pre-approval status, must-have versus nice-to-have criteria, and setting realistic expectations about the current market's competitiveness.
Seller onboarding typically includes a comparative market analysis to set realistic pricing, discussing needed repairs or staging, and agreeing on marketing approach and timeline expectations.

Having a written buyer or seller guide you send early in the relationship — covering the general process step by step — reduces repetitive explaining and helps clients feel more confident throughout an often unfamiliar process.

take: Onboard every client the same way, with a written guide.
